ana: quick sync 1 planning note: webinar next Thu, need final run order + 2 social captions + one fallback for demo.
kevin: proposed order: intro (ana) -> product (maya) -> benchmarks (kevin) -> live demo (sam) -> q&a. 45m total.
maya: ok. i'll keep product to 10m and reserve 5 slides for customer impact.
sam: demo will use dedicated pool. fallback = pre-recorded GIF + screenshot slide. will prep both.
ana: captions: A) "Cut inference cost, not quality. Join our engineers for benchmarks and a live demo." B) "Keep LLM features fast and cheap — practical strategies from the field." choose one for paid ads.
kevin: vote A for AB test. shorter.
maya: +1 A.
sam: rehearsals: tech check Tue 9am PT, full run Wed 4pm PT. can we do a 10-min warmup at T-2m to pre-warm caches?
ana: yes add KV warmup at -2m. ops note: pre-spin an extra node at -5m in us-east-1.
webinar-bot: recording ON, captions ON, chat moderation: AUTO_APPROVE.
kevin: CTA mapping: cost-review -> sales-opps pipeline; private-trial -> partner-engage. will map fields to HubSpot props and share sample payload.
maya: action items: sam upload demo GIF + screenshot, kevin share hubspot mapping, ana finalize caption by EOD. locking after that. :lock:
